setup: mkdir -p .scratch && python3 -c "import json; n=5; rows=[{'t':'2026-10-%02dT09:00:00Z'%(1+i%28),'event':'start','session':'s%02d'%i} for i in range(n)]; fires=[('planning',range(0,9)),('committing',range(2,9)),('tdd',range(5,9)),('debugging',range(10,12))]; rows+=[{'t':'2026-10-%02dT10:00:00Z'%(1+i%28),'skill':'foma-skills:'+s,'session':'s%02d'%i} for s,r in fires for i in r if i<n]; open('.scratch/fires.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\\n' for r in rows))"
git add -A . && git commit -qm 'Add fire log'
prompt: Which parts of the foma-skills pack are not earning their place in this project? Use what the project's own usage log says. Propose only, do not edit files.
checklist: The answer says the usage log is too short (5 sessions, fewer than 20) to conclude that any skill is unused, and does not name any skill as never used or propose disabling any pack skill from it.
